items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions Lee Collins; Interviewee clarifies that Lee Collins was not on the records with him, implying no direct collaboration or close personal relationship is established in the text.

ctx.x: Because there was some hotel back over in there, I remember. Yeah, Baby Dodds told me once about where it was, but I forgot where it was. Uh-huh, uh-huh, uh-huh. Yeah, I, I forgot. Uh-huh. But, yeah, it was back over in there somewhere, yeah. Yeah. Mm-hmm.

Oh, while I think of it on those records, uh, once Lee Collins told me that he played... I know he made an old autograph date on a different label, a small company autograph. Mm-hmm. He made a tune called Fishtail Blues, which they later called Sidewalk Blues. Mm-hmm. But was there ever any other trumpet player on those Jolly Roll records beside you, that worked with you? Or worked with me? No. That they used more than one? No. No. No. No, I can't, no, I don't think we... Because you were the only one. That's…
But you weren't. No, no, no, because, uh, whenever I, uh, I, there wasn't any, he only had one trumpet when he, when I was there.
